title: Randomized recognition with error bound
statement: A language $L$ belongs to the class at parameter $p$ if there are a randomized verifier $M$ and natural numbers $a,k$ such that the verifier is efficient according to $E$, and for every input $x$, its probability of outputting true is at least $p$ when $x\in L$, while its probability of outputting false is at least $p$ when $x\notin L$. In both cases the verifier uses randomness of length $a+k|x|$.
hypotheses_covered: A verifier M and natural numbers a,k exist
M is efficient according to E
For every x in L, the true-output probability is at least p
For every x outside L, the false-output probability is at least p
